opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. If applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. Project must be new build, refurbishment or equipment with capital costs of at least £50,000 and a funding shortfall of at least £25,000. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for organisations working with disability, supporting projects that help people live more independently, particularly training, employment and supported housing, and transitions from children's to adults' services.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. If applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. Project must be new build, refurbishment or equipment with capital costs of at least £50,000 and a funding shortfall of at least £25,000. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for charities working in mental health, with an emphasis on projects focusing on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. If applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC. Project must be new build, refurbishment or equipment with capital costs of at least £50,000 and a funding shortfall of at least £25,000. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with a neurodegenerative condition or who are isolated.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority operating a site of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance, open to the public for most of the year, and listed (Grade I/II*/Scheduled Monument in England & Wales, Category A/B in Scotland, Grade A/B+ in Northern Ireland). UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for conservation and restoration work, interpretation and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance with a clear emphasis on public access and engagement.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS. If applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or equivalent. Project must be new build, refurbishment or equipment with capital costs of at least £50,000 and a funding shortfall of at least £25,000. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for hospices and palliative care organisations providing excellent care to patients and their families, towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority operating a library or archive that is fully accredited under the Archive Service Accreditation Scheme, open to the public for most of the year, and holding a permanent collection of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections, usually for collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority operating a museum or gallery that is fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme and holds a permanent collection of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for museums and galleries to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority focused on professional performance, where performing arts constitute the vast majority of activities, able to make a case for the significance of its education work. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for performing arts organisations to improve their training and education facilities, generally towards building or refurbishing these facilities and occasionally specialist equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme if applicable. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for organisations with significant scientific or natural history collections to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. If applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. Project must be new build, refurbishment or equipment with capital costs of at least £50,000 and a funding shortfall of at least £25,000. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, supporting projects that help pupils at secondary level develop skills for employment or independent living after school or college.

opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities or research institutions undertaking internationally competitive research. The university Development Office should coordinate applications. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for research-intensive universities and research institutions towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research, and sometimes to improve access and research libraries or public engagement with science.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Maximum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £50,000 (equipment), £15,000 – £100,000 (new build and refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: State-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges with at least two years of exam results, inspected by Ofsted/Estyn/HMIE/ETI with an overall outcome of 'Good' or above, demonstrating excellence or significant progress towards excellence. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for high-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges to improve teaching at GCSE and A-Level of subjects needing specialist spaces and equipment (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music, performing arts). The 2026 funding round is closed; next round expected spring 2027.
